notes.title: Ramp Up the Battle with New Weapons and Obstacles in Socket Fighters!
notes.content:
Hello, Socket Fighters Fans,

The development team here at Socket Fighters is excited to give you a sneak peek into what we've been working on behind the scenes. We're still in the development phase, but we can't wait to share some of the exciting new features.

[b][h2]Handheld Weapons: More Ways to Fight[/h2][/b]

We've been experimenting with adding new handheld weapons to our game. We're aiming to make your battles more intense and action-packed. We believe these new tools will offer additional tactical options, providing more ways for you to gain the upper hand in the domestic arena. We're eager to see how you'll incorporate these into your strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43869629/5333ed354cf6bcb3ddf6ab134a8ed2b920d8b3ea.png[/img]

[b][h2]Obstacles: Making the Battlefields More Interactive[/h2][/b]

We're also working on adding new obstacles to the arenas in Socket Fighters. We want to make each room you fight in feel unique and challenging. That's why we're developing different kinds of obstacles, 
like barriers and sandbags. We believe these will offer new strategic possibilities and cover during battles.

But not all obstacles will be static. We're designing some that you can interact with, throw, and even use as weapons against your adversaries. We're excited to see how these interactive elements will enhance the dynamism and unpredictability of your matches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43869629/d78dde2b968ea5da6ecf82b17abf209c7abe28ac.jpg[/img]

Please stay tuned for more updates and thank you for your continued support of Socket Fighters!

Best Regards,
Paper Bunker Development Team

notes.title: The first sharing of our progress
notes.content:
Hey, community 🙂  
I want to share some progress from our side.

We made new animations for the background, and don't forget about the recent special attack - The epilepsy program 😅
[previewyoutube=ry0G6v_SkHk;full][/previewyoutube]

What we have now is a couple of ideas around the gameplay. Should be there two buttons (punch + kick) and in combination with a move you can make a special attack. Plus everything in the levels/maps is breakable, plus we will have active stuff in the level, which you can throw to your opponent, etc... To bring some chaos and physics to the game 🙂

So, if you have any ideas share them here or on our Discord - [url=https://discord.paperbunker.cz/]https://discord.paperbunker.cz/[/url]

Thanks for your support! ːsteamthumbsupː
